class.name: HEGoHDAPreset
class.brief_description: Saved parameter presets for one HDA, as the bottom panel's preset list stores them.
class.description: One resource per operator, written to [code]res://hego/presets/<operator>.tres[/code]. A preset is the blob [method HEGoAssetNode.get_preset] returns, which is also what a node's [code]parm_stash[/code] holds, so a preset and a stashed parameter set are the same thing saved in two places.

members.member: Preset name to the parameter blob saved under it.
